articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially launched GPT-5, featuring natively fused multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video with a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and complex multi-step code generation, narrowing the gap between LLM outputs and senior-engineer-level solutions in internal benchmarks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Discovery Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which set new records on MathOdyssey and ScienceBench by autonomously generating and verifying novel mathematical conjectures. The system combines reinforcement learning with chain-of-thought verification, producing outputs that were independently validated by peer reviewers in two published papers.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Factories
articles.summary: Tesla started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in three of its own manufacturing plants for materials handling and quality inspection tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models enabling real-time task adaptation without cloud connectivity.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Pilot to Full Assembly Line Integration
articles.summary: Figure AI announced a major expansion of its partnership with BMW, moving beyond isolated pilot stations to integrated assembly line workflows at BMW's Spartanburg plant. The Figure 02 robots now handle multi-step sub-assembly sequences with human coworkers, leveraging a foundation model for task planning that reduced retooling time by 70%.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Oversight Protocol for Autonomous AI Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new framework called Constitutional Oversight Protocol (COP) designed to govern autonomous AI agents operating in high-stakes environments such as infrastructure management and financial trading. COP enforces layered runtime constraints using a secondary monitor model that can halt and roll back agent actions, addressing a critical gap in agentic AI safety.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its N1.4 process node has entered high-volume manufacturing at its Kaohsiung fab, several months ahead of original projections. The node delivers approximately 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerators from Nvidia and Apple shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations at Record Fidelity
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum reported achieving below-threshold error rates on logical qubit operations using their hybrid trapped-ion architecture, sustaining 99.9% fidelity across 100 consecutive error-corrected cycles. This milestone represents a practical step toward scalable quantum computing and could accelerate timelines for commercially relevant quantum advantage in materials simulation.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Multimodal Models with Real-Time Video Understanding
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 under a permissive open-source license, featuring a family of models capable of real-time video stream comprehension and grounded spatial reasoning. The largest 400B-parameter variant matches proprietary frontier models on multiple benchmarks, significantly shifting the open-weight ecosystem's capabilities for enterprise and research deployments.
